verdict.rationale: Guided first-time workspace setup is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like monday.com, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents an onboarding walkthrough, setup wizard, or guided tour. The free-plan signup claim and the app-building prompts are adjacent features, not a guided setup flow.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can follow a guided walkthrough to set up my workspace the first time
